def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0]
    if rows:
        i = rows[0]
        a, b = grid[:i], grid[i + 1:]
        return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0 for x, y in zip(r, s)] for r, s in zip(a, b)]
    j = next(j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][j] != 0)
    width = min(j, w - j - 1)
    return [[2 if row[k] != 0 and row[j + 1 + k] != 0 else 0 for k in range(width)] for row in grid]
